messages:
alek: Quick ping — postmortem action items from the DB connection pool exhaustion incident are overdue. We committed owners + JIRA ids in the PM but a few items still show no progress. Can owners confirm status by EOD tomorrow?

karen: I own RED-7245 (increase pool + metrics). Started a branch but got blocked by infra quota. CC @samir for quota bump. ETA + progress updates in ticket. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samir: Sorry, bandwidth hit. I filed infra request with cloud team this morning (INC-5567) — waiting approval. If quota comes through today I can approve karen's change and promote.

alek: Thanks. If infra approval isn't in by 2pm I'll escalate to infra manager. This is one of the recurring patterns we flagged in the PM (see notes about weekly memory + connection spikes). We need closure to prevent repeat.

oncall-bot: Reminder: RED-7245 status still "In Progress" — assigned to karen. Due date 2026-04-03.

matt: I'm the owner for RED-7310 (add circuit breaker + synthetic monitor). I pushed a draft PR but haven't wired the alert -> runbook link. Plan to finish tomorrow morning. Will add the runbook link in PR description.

karen: Quick ask to owners: please add these two fields in the ticket before you mark done: 1) commit hash; 2) link to updated runbook section. That helps closure verification for the PM.

samir: Infra approval came through. I've bumped the quota for prod-redwood-gpupool. karen — you should be able to re-run CI and promote.

karen: Re-ran CI, fixed a small flake, and promoted. PR merged: 3b9f2d1. Updated RED-7245 with commit hash and notes. Set status to "Ready for Verify".

alek: Great — can @matt or @karen paste the runbook link here once added? I want to close the loop in the postmortem tracker.

matt: Runbook updated: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/db-connection-pool (section "circuit-breaker and synthetic checks"). Also linked RED-7310. PR merged: 7f2c3b1. Marked ticket as "Resolved".

alek: Ok thanks. Two outstanding asks before I mark postmortem follow-up as closed in the tracking sheet: 1) karen please confirm the deployment time window and whether we need a rollback playbook; 2) samir, note any quota changes as part of infra change log (INC-5567) so SRE can see long-term settings.

karen: Deployment was scheduled for 11:45 UTC today, no rollback required for this change (stateless config update). Documented in RED-7245.

samir: Logged quota change in INC-5567 with timestamp and reason. Also noted that we'll review pool sizing in the monthly capacity review to prevent recurrence.

alek: Perfect. I'm going to mark the PM action cluster as closed and add a note about the recurring pattern being addressed via monthly capacity review. If anything reopens, ping me and we'll re-escalate. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Action: Postmortem follow-up cluster for incident RED-2026-03 marked AS CLOSED by alek.

karen: Thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

matt: Closing note — let's add an automated synthetic that triggers at 80% of pool utilization to give earlier warning. I'll file RED-7341 as follow-up and aim for next sprint.

alek: Cool, please link RED-7341 to the PM. That addresses the recurring detection gap. Closing thread.
